gen-gf-turret-road-gf-gowun-dodum: Gowun Dodum reads smooth and tube-like, with a wide mouth on its lowercase a and no fuss anywhere. And Turret Road stands over it with round, parenthesis-like forms and a pen-drawn line, so the heading feels loud and the text feels settled.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-gruppo: Turret Road is bold and commanding, its round forms bending like open parentheses in one pen-like line. Gruppo follows as a plain sans, professional and clean, with curve endings that keep well away from each other.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-gudea: Round, confident, almost drawn by hand. Turret Road leads with that pen-like line, and Gudea settles in beneath with approachable curves and glass-clear gaps where each terminal meets its stroke.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-hanken-grotesk: Rounded, bold, unmistakably in charge. Turret Road brings parenthesis-shaped curves and a constant pen line, while Hanken Grotesk, a modern plain sans, bends like wire with wide channels leading into every counter.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-host-grotesk: Host Grotesk sweeps its curves open rather than curling them shut, giving a contemporary sans a light touch. Host Grotesk does the quiet work, while Turret Road takes the bold, commanding part with round forms and a line that never thins.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-hubot-sans: Hubot Sans is a modern sans with an e opened wide. Over a long page it moves along easily, while Turret Road above glows like neon tube, one steady line thickness throughout.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arab: A stroke that never changes weight gives Turret Road its skimming ease, with round forms like open parentheses. And IBM Plex Sans Arabic, a clean plain sans with readily open apertures, carries a longer passage along without any friction.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ibm-plex-sans-deva: IBM Plex Sans Devanagari is modern and contemporary, its rope-loose curves never knotting at the ends, while Turret Road overhead keeps its curves bold and unthinned. A longer passage in it flows loosely.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebr: Commanding from the first glance, Turret Road keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight. IBM Plex Sans Hebrew, a sans with open, uncrowded mouths on the s and c, gives that bold line an approachable partner.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: Bold, round and ruler-straight in its line weight, Turret Road shapes its forms like open parentheses. IBM Plex Sans JP, a professional plain sans, keeps a longer read approachable.
